verdict.rationale: Angular's source is hosted in a public first-party GitHub repository (github.com/angular/angular), so it can be read. However, nothing in the evidence names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. missing for 10: explicit open-source license identification (e.g. a LICENSE file or license name), first-party docs on licensing terms, independent corroboration of license openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Angular is a development platform for building mobile and desktop web applications using TypeScript/JavaScript and other languages.
Angular is cross-platform, fast, scalable, has incredible tooling, and is loved by millions.
